evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.973 Torr at Ar setpoint 100 sccm before growth.
Growth pressure began rising, reaching 3.030 Torr.
Pressure increased to 3.180 Torr despite unchanged temperature and argon setpoints.
Pressure reached 3.275 Torr while argon remained 100.1 sccm and temperature 749.6 C versus setpoints 100 sccm and 750 C; sustained pressure drift suggests a process anomaly.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed; atmosphere composition cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure range and independent pressure confirmation; leak and exhaust-conductance checks to distinguish air ingress from exhaust restriction. Oxygen measurement is needed to verify atmosphere purity. No sample characterization is available.
